source_text:
7.17
Καὶ ἐπὶ κορυφὴν αὐτοῦ ἡ ἀδικία αὐτοῦ καταβήσεται. ̔Η κορυφὴ νῦν τὸν νοῦν
σημαίνει, ει περ ὁ στέφανος τῆς χάριτος, κατὰ τὸν Σωλο μῶντα, η τις ἡ σοφία,
δέδεται τῇ κορυφῇ.
pass_a_gloss: And upon crown of-him the injustice of-him will-come-down. The crown now the mind signifies, if-indeed the crown of-the grace, according-to the Solomon, which-very-one the wisdom, has-been-bound to-the crown.
pass_b_english: “And on his crown his injustice will come down” (Psalm 7:17).
The crown now signifies the mind, if the crown of grace, according to Solomon, which is wisdom, is bound to the crown (Proverbs 4:9).

choices.why: κορυφή is the top of the head; Origen glosses it as νοῦς. Not a royal diadem as such, though he then cites Solomon’s στέφανος.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
